subject: Warm-up plan and temporary rate exceptions for Alpha Products launch
messages:
From: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 14 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Warm-up plan and temporary rate exceptions for Alpha Products launch

Hi team,

Alpha Products (Samir/Grace) are scheduled to flip traffic to production on 2027-08-16 15:00 PDT. Their GA launch is a high-visibility event and their integration team asked for a short warm-up window + temporary rate exceptions to avoid 429s while their client-side autoscalers stabilize.

Quick ask: can infra/prod provision a scoped, temporary rate exception and warm-up runway for the first 48 hours of the launch? Ballpark forecast attached (alpha_traffic_forecast_v2.csv) — the high-level numbers below: 
- Peak window: 2027-08-16 15:00–17:00 PDT (2 hours)
- Expected peak requests: 1,800 req/min (all endpoints)
- Avg tokens/request: 420 tokens (generation + system tokens)
- Expected sustained token throughput (peak): ~12,600 tokens/sec
- Concurrency estimate: ~120 concurrent sessions at peak

What we need from Product/Infra before the launch:
- Confirmation that a temporary rate exception (per-minute token & concurrency bump) can be scoped to "alpha-prod/launch" route only
- Any required model routing/fallbacks we should bake into the MAP to avoid cascading failures
- A succinct runbook snippet for on-call if tail latency spikes or 5xx rates increase

Attachments: alpha_launch_MAP_v3.pdf (mutual action plan), alpha_traffic_forecast_v2.csv

I can coordinate a 30-min pre-launch dry-run ~2 hours before the flip if infra wants it. Samir/Grace are flexible on the exact warm-up start time within a +-30m window.

Thanks — Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 14 Aug 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Warm-up plan and temporary rate exceptions for Alpha Products launch

On Sat, 14 Aug 2027 at 09:12, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai wrote:
> Alpha Products (Samir/Grace) are scheduled to flip traffic to production on 2027-08-16 15:00 PDT. ...

Thanks Lauren — good summary. A few clarifying items from Product's perspective before we sign off:

1) Model variant & quantization: which model are they calling in production (redwood-llama-xl-v2 / redwood-llama-xl-v2-q4)? If they're on a quantized path we need to confirm fallback compatibility (we can route to full-precision variant as a last resort).

2) Canary window: do we have a staged rollout (5% -> 25% -> 100%) or a Big Flip? Canary reduces the chance we blow the warm-up budget unnecessarily. If they do a Big Flip, we should coordinate a 10-minute "hold" after the first 5 minutes to verify latency/5xx.

3) Observability: please ensure the MAP includes the prompt-set we use for quality checks (so we can correlate perf regressions to quality). Product will add a quick automated smoke-check that runs every 15s during the warm-up window (simple token-level sanity checks).

Action items for Alpha that will unblock Product: exact model id + the rollout plan (percent steps and cadence).

I'll draft the quick smoke-check script and add it to the runbook. Attaching a short runbook snippet for infra (infra_runbook_snippet.md).

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Product — Serving
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 14 Aug 2027 12:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Warm-up plan and temporary rate exceptions for Alpha Products launch

Lauren/Karthik — we can accommodate a temporary, scoped rate exception and a warm-up runway. Notes from Infra: 

- Exception scope: route "alpha-prod/launch" (tenant-scoped) only; we will not change global account limits.
- Duration: configurable window; default to 48 hours starting from the first minute of the flip (we can make it 72h if legal asks).
- Exception id: EXC-2027-ALPHA-0421 (internal reference).
- Implementation: toggle (feature-flag) + policy in the router that raises per-minute token and concurrency ceilings for that route.

Operational constraints / asks from Infra: 
- Need exact model id and whether quantized variant is used (affects kernel selection and tail latency).
- Confirm expected sustained token/sec (you listed ~12,600 tokens/sec for peak) and the highest per-second burst. If you can confirm a conservative burst number (e.g., 22k tokens/sec) we'll pre-warm the procs.
- We will enable automatic fallback to redwood-llama-xl-v2-light if p95 request latency > 400ms for more than 3m; that fallback is only allowed for the launch route (we'll log a gated event).

Runbook excerpt (high-level):
1) If 5xx rate > 0.5% for > 5m -> rollback to previous route (feature-flag off) and notify on-call (pager).
2) If p95 latency > 600ms -> reduce concurrency limit by 25% and enable circuit-breaker to queue behind the primary path.
3) Escalation: tag INF-8723 when opening on-call incident.

I'll create the exception and a short-lived alert channel (alpha-prod-launch@pager.redwood.ai). Ben will be on-call during the flip window.

Ben Carter
SRE Lead, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai
From: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 14 Aug 2027 13:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Warm-up plan and temporary rate exceptions for Alpha Products launch

Perfect — thank you both.

Confirming the details from Alpha:
- Model: redwood-llama-xl-v2-q4 (quantized). We will request fallback to redwood-llama-xl-v2 (full-precision) only if the router triggers; they accept potential quality delta during fallback.
- Rollout: staged (5% -> 25% -> 100%) with 10-minute holds between steps.
- Burst conservative ask: 24,000 tokens/sec (to cover unforeseen client-side spike).

I've uploaded the signed MAP and forecast to Drive (link above). Legal approved the temporary SLA carve-out for the 48h window. Please proceed to:
- Create EXC-2027-ALPHA-0421 in the system (Ben)
- Enable the alpha-prod/launch route and the pager channel
- Karthik: share the smoke-check script and include it in the runbook

I'll schedule a 20-min pre-launch dry-run at 2027-08-16 13:00 PDT to exercise the warm-up path. Samir/Grace will join.

Thanks — Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
